source_of_truth: docs/design/operator-console-redesign.md — implement phased per §10, sequenced by dependency, with agent parity (§7) and render-truth as non-negotiables. Decisions locked via human gate: additive-extend operator-triage/v0; audit F001 alone then batch; Architecture under Work; pause after F001.
completion_test: The console renders the triaged 'what needs me' as a decision-first control tower: every visual element maps to a real operator-triage field (no UI-only state); trust is visible (proven_live filled vs hollow, stale demoted); resolution affordances replace copy-command-as-primary; one semantic token set themes light/dark + comfort/dense from one DOM; the terminal is OFF by default and shouts when armed; the architecture surface is a navigable per-level Mermaid map, not a 208KB flat graph. Each feature ships behind the existing page structure with vitest tests + evidence + (per cadence) a cross-model audit.

user_journeys.name: morning-triage
user_journeys.description: Operator opens Cockpit (fleet) and sees the few items that need them, ranked by bucket, with the next action attached; the rest collapses to counts; empty = 'you're clear'.

user_journeys.name: inspect-and-gate
user_journeys.description: Operator inspects why an item needs them (what/why_now/evidence/provenance/resolution) and approves/requests-changes/rejects a paused gate with one confirmation; the volley resumes.

user_journeys.name: trust-at-a-glance
user_journeys.description: Operator distinguishes proven-live from merely-asserted facts on sight (filled vs hollow dot, desaturated stale), per render-truth.

user_journeys.name: navigate-architecture
user_journeys.description: Operator descends a C4-style per-level Mermaid map (context->lanes->clusters->subgraph->module) and sees which nodes drifted since generation.

non_goals: Notifications (native OS vs in-app) — out of scope, flagged in §10
A backend/DB for the dashboard — it stays a static-file projection
Rewriting the orchestration/governance core — this is the renderer layer
